text: 10. In space, astronauts typically dump liquid waste (urine) out of a valve into the vacuum, where it freezes into a cloud of sparkling ice crystals. However, for a particular mission X Mission Control forbade the crew from dumping waste. The crew had to store every drop of urine in every available bag and container they could find. By the end of the mission, the Lunar Module was essentially a flying warehouse of bags taped to the walls, adding a literal foulness to the freezing, damp conditions. Id X.

11. Following Germany's humiliating exit at Euro 2000, the German FA (DFB) had pinned their hopes on Christoph Daum as the national team manager. But because Daum was still under contract at Bayer Leverkusen, the legendary player X—who had no coaching badges at the time—was hired merely to "warm the seat" for a year.
However, when Daum’s career imploded following a positive cocaine test in a scandal that rocked German sports, X was suddenly left as the permanent solution for a squad widely considered the least talented in generations. X took a “spit”, rode on his “Aunty Kathy” persona and a rigid defensive performance led by Oliver Kahn and took Germany to the finals of the 2002 World cup. Id X.
